Status: investigating existing middleware, version conventions, and tests before edits.
Constraint: external research and downloads unavailable; use local repository evidence.

+func FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx context.Context) semver.Version {

+		return version
+	}
+	return defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+}

+		version := defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+		if md, ok := metadata.FromIncomingContext(ctx); ok {
+			if values := md.Get(fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader); len(values) > 0 {
+				parsed, err := semver.ParseTolerant(values[0])
+				if err != nil {
+					logger.Debug("invalid accepted server version", zap.String("version", values[0]), zap.Error(err))
+				} else {
+					version = parsed
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return handler(WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx, version), req)
+	}
+}

+package grpc_middleware
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/blang/semver/v4"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
+)
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionContext(t *testing.T) {
+	version := semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}
+	ctx := WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(context.Background(), version)
+	require.Equal(t, version, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+	require.Equal(t, semver.Version{Major: 1}, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(context.Background()))
+}
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		header string
+		want   semver.Version
+	}{
+		{name: "prefixed", header: "v1.2.3", want: semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}},
+		{name: "unprefixed", header: "1.2.3", want: semver.Version{Major: 1, Minor: 2, Patch: 3}},
+		{name: "invalid", header: "invalid", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "empty", header: "", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			if tt.header != "" {
+				ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs("x-flipt-accept-server-version", tt.header))
+			}
+
+			called := false
+			_, err := FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(zaptest.NewLogger(t))(ctx, nil, nil, func(ctx context.Context, _ interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+				called = true
+				require.Equal(t, tt.want, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+				return nil, nil
+			})
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.True(t, called)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+var _ grpc.UnaryServerInterceptor = FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(nil)
